brief:
Floods sweeping through Gaza's tent camps have intensified hardship for displaced Palestinians already enduring extreme deprivation, The Guardian reported. Abdul Karim al-Sahhar and other families face deteriorating conditions as the season turns colder, with water damage compounding shortages of shelter and supplies in overcrowded settlements.

Aid organizations and residents express mounting anxiety about survival through the coming winter months. The combination of displacement, inadequate housing, and seasonal weather threatens vulnerable populations with disease, exposure, and further loss of resources already stretched to breaking point.

title: Winter looms as floods worsen Gaza displacement crisis
